administration.core.displayDescription: A Regular Empire administrative network that steadily produces Unity.
ark.core.displayDescription: A versatile support ship with heavy armor and strong shields. Builds Outposts and repairs fleets.
assembly.core.displayDescription: A Machine Intelligence assembly and repair center that builds Repair Drones.
battleship.core.displayDescription: A heavy laser main cannon and twin rapid-fire close-defense guns can retaliate against small ships at close range. No missile point defense.
battleship.action_upgradeBattleshipT2.de: Gains shields, self-repair and visible laser interception defenses.
battleship_missile.core.displayDescripti: Three long-range missiles per salvo and twin secondary guns provide saturation fire. Missiles can be intercepted by point defense and laser defenses.
battleship_missile_t2.core.displayDescri: Fires three long-range missiles per salvo with twin secondary guns. Missiles can be intercepted. Shields and self-repair improve survival; laser defenses intercept only a few missiles.
battleship_t2.core.displayDescription: A heavy laser main cannon and improved close-defense guns engage small ships. Has shields and self-repair; laser defenses consume stored energy to intercept missiles.
black_hole.core.displayDescription: Matter Decompressor construction target on dedicated maps. Produces no resources itself.
carrier_cruiser.core.displayDescription: A carrier platform that continuously replenishes attack craft. Main and secondary guns provide self-defense. No missile point defense.
carrier_cruiser_t2.core.displayDescripti: Continuously replenishes Strike Craft, with main and secondary guns for self-defense. Has shields and self-repair, but no missile point defense.
citadel.core.displayDescription: The final Starbase tier. Defends the empire with heavy armor and long-range firepower.
colony.core.displayDescription: Establishes a colony near an intact planet, producing Energy Credits, Minerals and Research each cycle.
colony.placementRule_nearPlanet.cannotPl: Can only establish a colony near an intact planet.
colony.placementRule_noColony.cannotPlac: There is already a colony nearby.
colossus.core.displayDescription: An age-four ultimate weapon equipped with the World Cracker, Neutron Sweep and Global Pacifier.
colossus.hiddenAction_announceCompletion: Word has reached us that an empire has completed a Colossus and brought it into service. This weapons platform can destroy an entire planet. The balance of power in the galaxy may have changed forever...
Our Colossus has left its assembly platform. The largest weapons platform in our history is now operational. This moment will mark a turning point for our empire.
colossus.action_worldCracker.description: A planet-killer weapon. A thermal stream heats the atmosphere and detonates the core, shattering the world with the resulting shockwave. Charges for 45 seconds and permanently destroys the target planet.
colossus.action_neutronSweep.description: A planet-killer weapon. An accelerated neutron plume sweeps the surface, destroying most living tissue. Charges for 45 seconds and clears the colony; the planet can be colonized again.
colossus.action_pacifier.description: A planet-killer weapon. Encloses a world in a permanent, impenetrable shield, cutting it off from the galaxy forever. Charges for 45 seconds and permanently seals the target planet.
colossus.action_worldCrackerGround.descr: Projects the World Cracker's thermal stream into the target area for a devastating nuclear-style strike. Does not permanently alter map terrain.
colossus.action_worldCrackerGround.showM: The World Cracker's thermal stream cuts across the sky. The atmosphere burns and the surface breaks under the impact. Even in this small corner of a planet, the end has come.
The World Cracker has fired. Its thermal stream is racing toward the target, where everything will be consumed by fire and shockwaves.
colossus.action_neutronGround.descriptio: Sweeps the target area with neutron radiation, eliminating ground forces and neutralizing surviving buildings. Airborne fleets are unaffected.
colossus.action_neutronGround.showMessag: A neutron plume sweeps the target area. Communications vanish one by one. Moments later, the wind replaces the sounds of life and war. The buildings still stand, but those who operated them are gone.
The Neutron Sweep has begun. Communications from the target area are falling silent one by one. Soon, only the wind will remain.
corvette.core.displayDescription: A fast screening ship with light rapid-fire lasers. No missile point defense.
corvette_kinetic.core.displayDescription: Rapid-fire, short-range kinetic guns suited to pursuing light ships. No missile point defense.
cruiser.core.displayDescription: A medium energy cannon and rapid-fire close-range secondary guns engage capital ships and small craft. No missile point defense.
cruiser.action_upgradeCruiserT2.descript: Gains energy shields and hull self-repair.
cruiser.action_quantumJump.description: Available after completing the Quantum Catapult. Choose a destination on the map. Charges for 20 seconds, costs Energy Credits and Strategic Resources per ship, and has a 150-second cooldown.
cruiser.action_quantumJump.isLockedMessa: Requires a completed Quantum Catapult on your team.
cruiser_missile.core.displayDescription: Twin long-range missiles and close-range secondary guns. Missiles can be intercepted by point defense and laser defenses; screening ships are recommended.
cruiser_missile_t2.core.displayDescripti: Twin long-range missiles and close-range secondary guns. Missiles can be intercepted. Has shields and self-repair, but no missile point defense.
cruiser_t2.core.displayDescription: Main and rapid-fire secondary guns engage large and small targets. Has shields and self-repair, but no missile point defense.
deep_mining_station.core.displayDescript: The final mining upgrade for ordinary deposits. Produces 16 Energy Credits, 16 Minerals and 0.25 Strategic Resources each cycle.
deep_mining_station_boosted.core.display: Enhanced by a Mineral Processing Plant. Produces 16 Energy Credits, 24 Minerals and 0.25 Strategic Resources each cycle.
defense_platform.core.displayDescription: Defends the starport with rapid-fire guns against small ships. Laser point defense consumes stored energy to intercept missiles.
destroyer.core.displayDescription: Medium screening ship. Laser point defense consumes stored energy to intercept missiles; secondary guns independently engage small ships.
destroyer_kinetic.core.displayDescriptio: Long-range kinetic guns and light secondary guns. Laser point defense consumes stored energy to intercept missiles, with less coverage than a standard Destroyer.
dyson_frame.core.displayDescription: Second megastructure stage. Produces vast amounts of Energy Credits when complete.
dyson_frame.action_completeDyson.descrip: Installs all energy collection arrays and starts Energy production.
dyson_site.core.displayDescription: First megastructure stage. Build the frame before completing the Dyson Sphere. Limited to one per team at a time.
dyson_site.action_buildDysonFrame.descri: Second megastructure stage. Does not yet produce Energy Credits.
dyson_sphere.core.displayDescription: An age-four megastructure. Produces 60 Energy Credits (shown as $) each cycle.
dyson_sphere.hiddenAction_announceComple: The last glow of a star has vanished from the star charts. A Dyson Sphere has closed around it, placing the star's entire energy output in its builders' hands.
Our Dyson Sphere has fully enclosed its star. Our engineers have accomplished a feat few empires have matched, and the star's entire energy output now flows into our realm.
engineer.core.displayDescription: Builds starport facilities and repairs friendly buildings.
engineer.action_upgradeArk.description: Adds shields, light defensive guns and improved nanoconstruction systems.
engineer.canBuild_mineralPlant.isLockedA: Your team may have only one Mineral Processing Plant, including those under construction.
engineer.canBuild_fleetAcademy.isLockedM: Requires Destroyer Hull technology. Your team may have only one Fleet Academy, including those under construction.
engineer.canBuild_hyperRelayA.isLockedMe: Requires Hyper Relay technology and Hyperlane Exit A. Your team must not already own Relay A.
engineer.canBuild_hyperRelayB.isLockedMe: Requires Hyper Relay technology and Hyperlane Exit B. Your team must not already own Relay B.
engineer.canBuild_administration.isLocke: Only Regular Empire teams can build this.
engineer.canBuild_assembly.isLockedMessa: Only Machine Intelligence teams can build this.
engineer.canBuild_hatchery.isLockedMessa: Only Hive Mind teams can build this.
engineer.canBuild_dysonSite.isLockedMess: Requires Dyson Sphere technology. Your team must not already have a Dyson Sphere project.
engineer.canBuild_matterSite.isLockedMes: Requires Matter Decompressor technology. Your team must not already have a Matter Decompressor project.
engineer.canBuild_megaShipyardSite.isLoc: Requires Mega Shipyard technology. Your team must not already have a Mega Shipyard project.
engineer.canBuild_scienceNexusSite.isLoc: Requires Science Nexus technology. Your team must not already have a Science Nexus project.
engineer.canBuild_quantumCatapultSite.is: Requires Quantum Catapult technology. Your team must not already have a Quantum Catapult project.
engineer.canBuild_tianjiInstitute.isLock: Requires Celestial Engineering research. Your team may have only one Institute of Celestial Secrets, including those under construction.
enigma_battlecruiser.core.displayDescrip: A Fallen Empire capital ship with twin spinal cannons, independently targeting secondary guns, powerful shields and energy-limited laser point defense that intercepts missiles.
fallen_titan.core.displayDescription: An ancient flagship. Its spinal annihilation cannon, rapid-fire secondary guns and guided missiles target independently. Heavy shields and energy-limited point defense protect the hull; repairs nearby fleets.
fallen_titan.hiddenAction_announceComple: A Fallen Empire Titan has entered service. An ancient hull has returned to the star charts, bearing a main cannon powerful enough to reshape the battlefield.
Our Fallen Empire Titan is complete. Ancient blueprints deciphered by our researchers have become the flagship of our fleet.
fighter.core.displayDescription: A fast, short-range anti-air craft suited to escorting large ships. No missile point defense.
fleet_academy.core.displayDescription: Limited to one per team. Fleet Training strengthens your team's combat ships; the bonus ends if the Academy is destroyed or dismantled.
fleet_academy.action_trainFleet.descript: While the Academy survives, your team's combat ships gain about 15% maximum hull and 10% firepower. Rebuilding the Academy requires researching the training again.
fortress.core.displayDescription: A tier-three Starbase with stronger firepower and defenses.
fortress.action_upgradeCitadel.descripti: Upgrades to the final Starbase tier.
foundry.core.displayDescription: Consumes 3 Minerals and 2 Energy Credits every 2 seconds to produce 2 Alloys. Stops if resources are insufficient. Can be upgraded.
foundry.action_upgradeFoundryT2.descript: Consumes 7 Minerals and 4 Energy Credits every 2 seconds to produce 5 Alloys.
foundry_t2.core.displayDescription: Consumes 7 Minerals and 4 Energy Credits every 2 seconds to produce 5 Alloys. Stops if resources are insufficient. Can be upgraded.
foundry_t2.action_upgradeFoundryT3.descr: Consumes 14 Minerals and 8 Energy Credits every 2 seconds to produce 10 Alloys.
foundry_t3.core.displayDescription: Consumes 14 Minerals and 8 Energy Credits every 2 seconds to produce 10 Alloys. Stops if resources are insufficient.
generator.core.displayDescription: Produces 12 Energy Credits (shown as $) each cycle.
generator.action_upgradeGeneratorT2.desc: Increases Energy output on site to 24 per cycle.
generator_t2.core.displayDescription: Produces 24 Energy Credits ($) each cycle on the same footprint.
generator_t2.action_upgradeGeneratorT3.d: Increases Energy output on site to 48 per cycle.
generator_t3.core.displayDescription: Produces 48 Energy Credits ($) each cycle on the same footprint.
hatchery.core.displayDescription: Rapidly replenishes Swarm Ships for the Hive Mind and steadily produces Unity.
hyper_relay_a.core.displayDescription: Built near Hyperlane Exit A. Once your team's Relay B is complete, nearby ships can transit in both directions.
hyper_relay_a.placementRule_nearExitA.ca: Can only be built near Hyperlane Exit A on dedicated maps.
hyper_relay_a.action_launchToB.descripti: Transports up to 8 nearby ships on your team to your team's Relay B.
hyper_relay_b.core.displayDescription: Built near Hyperlane Exit B. Once your team's Relay A is complete, nearby ships can transit in both directions.
hyper_relay_b.placementRule_nearExitB.ca: Can only be built near Hyperlane Exit B on dedicated maps.
hyper_relay_b.action_launchToA.descripti: Transports up to 8 nearby ships on your team to your team's Relay A.
ion_cannon.core.displayDescription: A heavy stationary cannon with a slow fire rate and powerful individual shots. Its fire cannot be intercepted by missile point defense or laser defenses.
juggernaut.core.displayDescription: An age-four mobile shipyard that builds and repairs ships at the front. Main and twin secondary guns provide self-defense; no missile point defense. Its Fire Control aura grants friendly and allied combat starships within 650 range +10% weapon damage and +10% fire rate. Multiple Juggernauts do not stack; Juggernauts and Colossi receive no bonus.
juggernaut.hiddenAction_announceCompleti: An Empire's Trump Card\nAn empire has confirmed the completion of a massive Juggernaut. This mobile starbase combines immense firepower with the ability to build and service ships at the front, making it a formidable threat in any theater of war.\nThis is truly the cutting edge of space warfare.

Sovereign of the Void
Our mighty Juggernaut is complete.
This mobile behemoth will transform offensive warfare. It can build and repair ships at the front, and its overwhelming firepower will let us maintain relentless pressure on any who dare oppose us.
Only fools would stand against us now.
juggernaut.canBuild_cruiserT2.isLockedMe: Requires Cruiser Hull and Shield Generator technologies.
juggernaut.canBuild_cruiserMissileT2.isL: Requires Cruiser, Long-Range Missile and Shield technologies.
juggernaut.canBuild_carrierCruiserT2.isL: Requires Carrier Operations and Shield technologies.
juggernaut.canBuild_battleshipT2.isLocke: Requires Battleship Hull and Shield technologies.
Requires Battleship, Long-Range Missile and Shield technologies.
juggernaut.canBuild_riddleEscort.isLocke: Requires the Riddle Escort Hull breakthrough from the Institute of Celestial Secrets.
Requires the Enigma Battlecruiser Hull breakthrough from the Institute of Celestial Secrets.
juggernaut.canBuild_fallenTitan.isLocked: Requires the Fallen Empire Titan Hull breakthrough from the Institute of Celestial Secrets.
matter_decompressor.core.displayDescript: An age-four black-hole megastructure. Produces 50 Minerals each cycle.
matter_decompressor.hiddenAction_announc: A Matter Decompressor at the edge of a black hole is now operational. Streams of matter once beyond reach are being redirected into an empire's industrial network.
Our Matter Decompressor is operating steadily. Minerals drawn from the edge of a black hole will feed our shipyards and factories, sustaining the expansion to come.
matter_frame.core.displayDescription: Second megastructure stage. Produces large amounts of Minerals when complete.
matter_frame.action_completeMatter.descr: Activates the black-hole matter extraction array.
matter_site.core.displayDescription: Can only be built near a black hole on dedicated maps. Limited to one per team at a time.
A Matter Decompressor can only be built near a black hole.
matter_site.action_buildMatterFrame.desc: Second megastructure stage. Does not yet produce Minerals.
mega_shipyard.core.displayDescription: An age-four megastructure that builds imperial fleets at four times a normal Shipyard's speed. Can directly build researched T2 capital ships; a single queue still completes one ship at a time.
mega_shipyard.hiddenAction_announceCompl: A Mega Shipyard is fully operational. Its immense construction facilities are turning resources into fleets, forcing the galaxy's empires to reassess its builders' military potential.
The last fabrication district of our Mega Shipyard is online. Our fleets will take shape here, and our shipbuilding capacity can now sustain distant campaigns.
mega_shipyard.canBuild_battleshipMissile: Requires Battleship Hull and Long-Range Missile technologies.
mega_shipyard.canBuild_titan.isLockedMes: Requires Titan Hull technology. Your team must not already have a Titan.
mega_shipyard.canBuild_juggernaut.isLock: Requires Juggernaut Hull technology. Your team must not already have a Juggernaut.
mega_shipyard.canBuild_colossus.isLocked: Requires Colossus Hull technology. Your team must not already have a Colossus.
mega_shipyard_frame.core.displayDescript: Second megastructure stage. Builds capital ships when complete.
mega_shipyard_site.core.displayDescripti: First megastructure stage. Limited to one per team at a time.
mega_shipyard_site.action_buildMegaShipy: Second megastructure stage. Does not yet build ships.
mineral_plant.core.displayDescription: Increases Minerals output from all Mining Stations on your team by 50%. Limited to one per team.
mining_station.core.displayDescription: Produces 4 Minerals each cycle at a deposit.
mining_station_boosted.core.displayDescr: Produces 6 Minerals each cycle at a deposit. A Mineral Processing Plant provides a 50% bonus.
mining_station_t2.core.displayDescriptio: Produces 8 Minerals each cycle at a deposit.
mining_station_t2_boosted.core.displayDe: Produces 12 Minerals each cycle at a deposit. A Mineral Processing Plant provides a 50% bonus.
mining_station_t3.core.displayDescriptio: Produces 16 Minerals each cycle at a deposit.
mining_station_t3.action_upgradeDeepMini: Upgrade to Deep Separation Mining Station
Final mining upgrade. Separates an additional 0.25 Strategic Resources each cycle.
mining_station_t3_boosted.core.displayDe: Produces 24 Minerals each cycle at a deposit. A Mineral Processing Plant provides a 50% bonus.
mining_station_t3_boosted.action_upgrade: Retains the Mineral Processing Plant bonus and separates an additional 0.25 Strategic Resources each cycle.
missile_platform.core.displayDescription: A stationary long-range launcher. Its missiles can be intercepted by point defense.
native_gun_t3_bridge.core.displayDescrip: A tier-three heavy machine-gun emplacement. Can be converted into a self-repairing Planetary Defense Platform.
native_gun_t3_bridge.action_upgradeDefen: Converts on site into a 1x2 Planetary Defense Platform with stronger anti-ship firepower and missile defense.
native_repair_bay_bridge.core.displayDes: Repairs nearby friendly units and buildings. Can be upgraded to a Repair Base.
native_repair_bay_bridge.action_upgradeR: Expands the repair facilities on site, increasing repair range and speed.
native_sam_t3_bridge.core.displayDescrip: A tier-three SAM platform. Can be converted into a Planetary Missile Platform.
native_sam_t3_bridge.action_upgradeMissi: Converts on site into a 1x2 Planetary Missile Platform for anti-ship fire and ground bombardment.
outpost.core.displayDescription: A frontier outpost built by an Ark. Can be upgraded to its empire's Starbase.
outpost.action_upgradeRegular.descriptio: Develops the Outpost into a Regular Empire Starbase.
planet_arms01.core.displayDescription: Unclaimed planet Arms01. Construction Ships can establish a colony nearby.
planet_arms01.hiddenAction_worldCrack.sh: The crust of Arms-01 · Core has fractured, and its magnetosphere is disintegrating. The spectacle of a world's death is difficult to comprehend, yet as its searing core cools in the cold of space, the beauty of that death is undeniable.
planet_arms01.hiddenAction_pacify.showMe: The dazzling light above Arms-01 · Core has faded, and the world has fallen silent. History may judge the complete isolation of a planet from the universe to be extreme and unjustifiable. Perhaps it will not. Either way, only a planet-sized crystal sphere remains.
planet_arms01_occupied.core.displayDescr: Colonized planet Arms01, controlled by the team that owns the nearby colony.
planet_arms01_occupied.hiddenAction_neut: The sweep of Arms-01 · Core is complete, and the neutron plume is dispersing. Scans detect no signs of sapient life. Some would call this erasure of life, leaving only inorganic matter, an evil war crime. Those responsible call it efficient.
planet_arms01_sealed.core.displayDescrip: Permanently sealed planet Arms01. Cannot be colonized again this match.
planet_arms01_shattered.core.displayDesc: Permanently shattered planet Arms01. Cannot be colonized again this match.
planet_arms02.core.displayDescription: Unclaimed planet Arms02. Construction Ships can establish a colony nearby.
planet_arms02.hiddenAction_worldCrack.sh: The crust of Arms-02 · West Ring has fractured, and its magnetosphere is disintegrating. The spectacle of a world's death is difficult to comprehend, yet as its searing core cools in the cold of space, the beauty of that death is undeniable.

planet_galaxy05.hiddenAction_pacify.show: The dazzling light above Shattered-05 · South Reach has faded, and the world has fallen silent. History may judge the complete isolation of a planet from the universe to be extreme and unjustifiable. Perhaps it will not. Either way, only a planet-sized crystal sphere remains.
planet_galaxy05_occupied.core.displayDes: Colonized planet Galaxy05, controlled by the team that owns the nearby colony.
planet_galaxy05_occupied.hiddenAction_ne: The sweep of Shattered-05 · South Reach is complete, and the neutron plume is dispersing. Scans detect no signs of sapient life. Some would call this erasure of life, leaving only inorganic matter, an evil war crime. Those responsible call it efficient.
planet_galaxy05_sealed.core.displayDescr: Permanently sealed planet Galaxy05. Cannot be colonized again this match.
planet_galaxy05_shattered.core.displayDe: Permanently shattered planet Galaxy05. Cannot be colonized again this match.

planet_lab.core.displayDescription: A tier-two Research Station that retains all technology research options.
planet_lab.action_researchDestroyer.desc: Spends Research and Minerals to permanently unlock Destroyers for your team.
planet_lab.action_researchDestroyer.isLo: Upgrade the Planetary Command Center to a Starbase first.
planet_lab.action_researchCruiser.descri: Spends Research and Alloys to permanently unlock Cruisers for your team.
planet_lab.action_researchKinetics.descr: Unlocks Kinetic Corvettes and Kinetic Destroyers.
planet_lab.action_researchMissiles.descr: Unlocks Missile Cruisers and Missile Battleships.
planet_lab.action_researchBattleship.des: Unlocks an age-three long-range capital ship.
planet_lab.action_researchCarrier.descri: Unlocks Escort Craft and Carrier Cruisers.
planet_lab.action_researchCitadel.isLock: Requires Star Fortress and Battleship technology.
planet_lab.action_researchShields.descri: Unlocks a defensive installation that regenerates its own shields and intercepts projectiles.
planet_lab.action_researchIonCannon.desc: Unlocks a heavy stationary cannon designed to engage large ships.
planet_lab.action_researchTitan.descript: Unlocks an age-four flagship. Requires Battleship and Citadel technologies.
planet_lab.action_researchJuggernaut.des: Unlocks a mobile shipyard that builds and repairs ships.
planet_lab.action_researchColossus.descr: Unlocks an age-four planet-killer weapon. Limited to one per team at a time.
planet_lab.action_researchColossus.showM: The Colossus Project, our monumental effort to design the largest weapons platform in our history and equip it with a planet-killer, has borne fruit and is nearing completion. Our first Colossus is yet to be built, but this moment will mark a turning point in our history.
planet_lab.action_researchColossusMachin: The Colossus Project is complete. New ship type available: Colossus. New weapon components available: World Cracker, Neutron Sweep and Global Pacifier.
planet_lab.action_researchColossusHive.s: We now fully understand the Colossus design and can begin assembly. With considerable effort, we have also learned to control its nightmarish planet-killer weapons.
planet_lab.action_researchDyson.descript: Unlocks an age-four energy megastructure. Limited to one per team at a time.
planet_lab.action_researchMatter.descrip: Unlocks an age-four Minerals megastructure built near black holes.
planet_lab.action_researchMegaShipyard.d: Unlocks an age-four fleet construction megastructure.
planet_lab.action_researchMegaShipyard.i: Requires Citadel and Juggernaut Hull technology.
planet_lab.action_researchQuantumCatapul: Unlocks the Quantum Catapult. Once complete, capital ships can make long-range jumps on both ordinary and dedicated maps.
Requires Citadel technology and a completed Science Nexus.
planet_lab.action_researchHyperRelay.des: Unlocks facilities for bidirectional fleet transit along hyperlanes on dedicated maps.
planet_lab.action_researchHyperRelay.isL: Requires Starhold and Cruiser Hull technology.
planet_lab.action_researchTianjiEngineer: Available after completing a Science Nexus. Unlocks the Institute of Celestial Secrets to decipher Fallen Empire ship technology.
Requires a completed Science Nexus first.

planet_unclaimed.core.displayDescription: A colonizable neutral planet. Construction Ships can establish a colony nearby.
pre_ftl_builder.core.displayDescription: A pre-FTL civilization's ground construction unit. Can be upgraded to a Construction Ship in the interstellar age.
pre_ftl_builder.action_upgradeEngineer.d: Converts a ground Builder into an interstellar Construction Ship.
pre_ftl_builder.action_upgradeEngineer.i: Upgrade the Command Center to a Starbase first.
pre_ftl_command.core.displayDescription: A pre-FTL civilization's capital. Choose an empire type, then upgrade it into a Starbase on the same site.
pre_ftl_command.action_researchFTL.descr: Completes the basic research needed to enter the interstellar age.
pre_ftl_command.action_regular.text: Develop into a Regular Interstellar Empire
pre_ftl_command.action_regular.descripti: Requires Faster-Than-Light Theory. Spends 5000 Energy Credits and 150 Minerals to upgrade to a Starbase.
pre_ftl_mine.core.displayDescription: Produces 8 Energy Credits and 2 Minerals at a resource node. Can be upgraded on site into a Mining Station in the interstellar age.
pre_ftl_mine.action_upgradeMining.descri: Upgrades the mining facilities on site and increases Minerals output after entering the interstellar age.
quantum_catapult.core.displayDescription: Unlocks long-range jumps to chosen destinations for your team's capital ships. High-difficulty AI can organize fleet raids against the enemy economy.
quantum_catapult.hiddenAction_announceCo: A Quantum Catapult has completed its final calibration and entered service. Fleets can now cross vast distances, putting established frontier defenses to a new test.
Our Quantum Catapult's final calibration is complete. Capital fleets can prepare for long-range transit, extending our reach beyond conventional routes.
quantum_catapult_frame.core.displayDescr: Second megastructure stage. Unlocks long-range jumps for capital ships when complete.
quantum_catapult_frame.action_completeQu: Unlocks long-range jumps for your team's capital ships.
quantum_exit_a.core.displayDescription: A fixed transit target for the Quantum Catapult.
rare_deposit.core.displayDescription: Rare deposit placement marker on dedicated maps.
repair_drone.core.displayDescription: Exclusive to Machine Intelligences. Repairs ships and facilities at low cost. Unarmed.
research_station.core.displayDescription: Produces Research for future technology unlocks.
research_station.action_upgradePlanetLab: Increases Research output on site while retaining the technology research menu.
riddle_escort.core.displayDescription: A Fallen Empire screening ship with rapid energy cannons, heavy shields and energy-limited laser point defense that intercepts missiles.
science_nexus.core.displayDescription: An age-four research megastructure. Produces 45 Research each cycle.
science_nexus.hiddenAction_announceCompl: A Science Nexus has been completed. Its vast research facilities are propelling its builders to the forefront of galactic science, a development scholars across the galaxy will watch closely.
Our Science Nexus opens today. The empire's finest researchers will gather here to explore the universe's unanswered mysteries. This project begins a new age of discovery.
science_nexus_frame.core.displayDescript: Second megastructure stage. Produces large amounts of Research when complete.
science_nexus_site.action_buildScienceNe: Second megastructure stage. Does not yet produce Research.
science_ship.core.displayDescription: Explores the starfield. Anomaly investigation is planned for dedicated maps.
shield_generator.core.displayDescription: Regenerates its own shields. Laser defenses consume stored energy to intercept nearby missiles, but cannot stop naval cannon fire or Colossus strikes.
shipyard.core.displayDescription: Builds the infrastructure for the imperial fleet.
starbase.core.displayDescription: Produces 24 Energy Credits and 2 Minerals each cycle, repairs fleets within range and defends the capital.
starbase_hive.core.displayDescription: A Hive Mind's initial starport, with higher base currency production.
starbase_machine.core.displayDescription: A Machine Intelligence's initial starport, with higher Energy production.
starbase_origin.core.displayDescription: Choose a Regular Empire, Machine Intelligence or Hive Mind.
starbase_origin.action_regular.descripti: Choose a Regular Interstellar Empire with balanced development.
starbase_origin.action_machine.descripti: Choose a Machine Intelligence focused on industry and repair.
starbase_origin.action_hive.description: Choose a Hive Mind focused on rapid replenishment.
starhold.core.displayDescription: A tier-two Starbase with stronger defenses that continues to build civilian ships.
strategic_extractor.core.displayDescript: Extracts Strategic Resources from rare deposits for endgame technologies.
strategic_extractor.placementRule_rareDe: Can only be built on a rare deposit.
strike_craft.core.displayDescription: Attack craft deployed by Carrier Cruisers. Uses numbers and mobility to sustain pressure on enemy ships. No missile point defense.
swarm_ship.core.displayDescription: Exclusive to Hive Minds. Replenishes quickly and slowly repairs itself. Shorter range than a Corvette. No missile point defense.
tianji_institute.core.displayDescription: Attempts to decipher Fallen Empire ship technology every 180 seconds, with a 90% failure chance. Success unlocks one unowned technology. Attempts stop once all are unlocked.
tianji_institute.hiddenAction_discoveryF: Institute of Celestial Secrets: this attempt failed to unravel the mysteries of Fallen Empire technology. The research teams will keep trying.
tianji_institute.hiddenAction_discoverEs: Breakthrough at the Institute of Celestial Secrets: Riddle Escort hulls unlocked! Shipyards, Mega Shipyards and Juggernauts can now build this Fallen Empire screening ship.
tianji_institute.hiddenAction_discoverBa: Breakthrough at the Institute of Celestial Secrets: Enigma Battlecruiser hulls unlocked! Shipyards, Mega Shipyards and Juggernauts can now build this twin-cannon capital ship.
tianji_institute.hiddenAction_discoverTi: Breakthrough at the Institute of Celestial Secrets: Fallen Empire Titan hulls unlocked! Shipyards, Mega Shipyards and Juggernauts can now build this ancient flagship.
titan.core.displayDescription: An age-four flagship with a heavy main cannon, twin rapid-fire secondary guns and interceptable missiles. Repairs nearby friendly ships.
titan.hiddenAction_announceCompletion.sh: A Titan has entered service. Armed with multiple weapon systems and able to support nearby fleets, this immense warship is shifting the balance of galactic naval power.
Our Titan has joined the fleet. Combining heavy firepower with fleet support, this flagship will form the core of our expeditionary forces.
titan.action_upgradeParadoxTitan.descrip: Gains powerful shields, laser point defense, improved main and secondary guns, and a repair aura.
titan_paradox.core.displayDescription: An ultimate flagship with heavy shields against capital-ship fire. Its main cannon, twin rapid-fire secondary guns and guided missiles target independently; laser defenses intercept a limited number of missiles.
titan_paradox.hiddenAction_announceCompl: A Paradox Titan has completed its refit. Heavy shields and improved naval guns make it a mobile fortress that only the fiercest attacks can shake.
Our Paradox Titan's refit is complete. Protected like a mobile fortress, it will endure enemy fire and defend the fleet with its main cannon and escort weapons.
trade_hub.core.displayDescription: Generates 16 Energy Credits ($) through trade each cycle.
all-units.hiddenAction_receiveAllyColoss: Word has reached us that our allies have completed a Colossus and brought it into service. This weapons platform can destroy an entire planet. As ever, they are ahead of their time.
mod.description: An unofficial Stellaris-inspired space strategy mod for Rusted Warfare.
